entry.title: What is the Use of Private Environment in SAP Build Process Automation Control Tower?
entry.content:
Hi Experts,

I am curious to understand the purpose of the Private Environment option in SAP Build Process Automation Control Tower.

Currently, we have:

  • Shared Environment
  • Public Environment
  • Private Environment if user activate it

These environments are available while deploying processes. However, when I try to deploy a process, I do not see an option to select the Private Environment.

Because of this, I am confused about the actual use case of the Private Environment in SAP BPA Control Tower.

My questions are:

  1. What is the purpose of a Private Environment in SAP BPA?
  2. In which scenarios is it used?
  3. Why is it not available as a deployment option while deploying processes?
  4. Is it related to agent-based execution, runtime isolation, or tenant-level configuration?

It would be helpful if someone could explain the architecture or practical usage of Private Environments in real projects.

Thanks in advance!

entry.title: BAPI_ACC_DOCUMENT_POST Commit Behaviour and API_CV_ATTACHMENT_SRV Object Validation
entry.content:
Dear SAP Community

We are seeking clarification on the transaction and object validation behaviour of SAP S/4HANA 2025 in the context of an automated process designed with SAP Build Process Automation to process accounting documents.

In SAP Build Process Automation our integration pattern is:

BAPI_ACC_DOCUMENT_POST

↓

Accounting Document Number Returned

↓

POST API_CV_ATTACHMENT_SRV / AttachmentContentSet

In S/4HANA 2025, we observed that an immediate attachment upload may intermittently return HTTP 400, while introducing a short delay (500 ms) eliminates the issue in our tests.

Questions

1. Does a successful return from BAPI_ACC_DOCUMENT_POST guarantee that the Accounting Document is already committed and visible in the database to subsequent HTTP/OData requests?

2. When the SAP Build BAPI SDK is configured with Commit = True, does it execute BAPI_TRANSACTION_COMMIT?

o If yes, is WAIT = 'X' used?

o Is the behaviour equivalent to COMMIT WORK or COMMIT WORK AND WAIT?

3. Could there be a delay between successful document posting and visibility of the document to API_CV_ATTACHMENT_SRV, even when the commit is successful?

4. What object or persistence layer is validated by AttachmentContentSet when uploading an attachment to an Accounting Document?

o Does the service validate directly against BKPF?

o Or through another business object/service layer?

5. Is adding a short delay or retry mechanism before calling AttachmentContentSet considered an acceptable integration pattern, or is there a preferred SAP-recommended approach?

It would be great to at least have some of the above questions answered so that we can align our SAP Build integration design with SAP best practices.

entry.title: Joule Studio agent deployment fails with "Tenant Administration Worker - 6002" and HTTP 500.
entry.content:
Hi everyone,

We are experiencing deployment issues in SAP Build Joule Studio (classic edition) and are trying to determine the root cause.

Issue

When deploying a Joule agent, deployment fails with errors similar to:

Create agent request failed with status code 500
INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR
Tenant Administration Worker - 6002

We also receive a warning stating:

 
An intermittent issue with Joule is currently preventing the role check.​

What we have already verified

  • AI Agent Builder Activation is enabled.
  • The user has the extensibility_developer role.
  • The deployment environment exists and is selectable.
  • Previously working versions of the same agent now fail as well.
  • Re-deploying older versions (which deployed successfully in the past) results in the same error.

Because even historical working versions are failing, we are starting to suspect a tenant or platform-related issue rather than an issue with the agent itself.

Question

Has anyone seen deployment failures with Tenant Administration Worker - 6002 before?

Could exhausted AI Units, AI Core quotas, or other AI-related entitlements cause this type of deployment failure, or would a different error typically be expected in that scenario?

Any guidance on where to investigate next would be greatly appreciated.

Thanks!

entry.title: SBPA deploy fails 3 weeks: Integration Gateway returns 500 compiling all projects
entry.content:
Hi all,

For roughly three weeks we have been unable to reliably deploy any SAP Build Process Automation project. An incident is open with SAP support but has not progressed, so I am posting here in case others are seeing the same behavior or know of a workaround.

ERROR

When deploying any project, the deployment fails with:

"The project (ID: <project id>, version: X.Y.Z) in the environment (ID: <env>) could not be deployed."

More details: "Errors occurred while deploying an artifact to a runtime. (component: Integration Gateway)"

Followed by a list of: "Compilation failed for project <project id>: Request failed with status code 500"

The listed projects are unrelated to the one being deployed. The error enumerates many other projects in the tenant, all failing compilation at the same time with the same 500.

In one case the dialog itself stated: "An error occurred in the Integration Gateway during agent compilation. Please use the Copy Error Details button to copy the error information and include it when opening a support ticket (SNOW)."

WHAT WE HAVE ALREADY RULED OUT

- Not specific to one project: fails on several existing projects deployed in isolation.

- Not specific to project content: fails on a brand-new project containing a single trivial Condition step.

- Not specific to Joule Studio: fails equally on a plain Process Automation project with no Skill or Joule artifact.

- Not specific to one environment: reproduced in both a Shared Environment and a Private Environment.

- Not specific to deployment: the same failure occurs when running Test.

- Not specific to region: we created a brand-new subaccount in EU10 and the failure reproduces there as well.

- Not an Agent version issue: Agent version 3.44.

- Design Console reports 0 errors in all cases.

OBSERVED PATTERN

The first release and deploy early in the morning generally succeeds. After that, every subsequent deploy on the same day fails with the above error, consistently, including re-deploying an already released version with no changes at all.

QUESTIONS

1. Is anyone else currently seeing Integration Gateway returning 500 during project compilation?

2. Is there any known workaround beyond retrying?

3. Is it expected that deploying one project triggers recompilation of every other project in the environment? If so, is there a way to limit that scope?

Any pointers appreciated. Happy to provide correlation IDs and full error details.

Thanks.
